about_the_game:
Overview:
You suddenly get a call that your father has gone missing and this Inn is all that he left behind for you. You must now work at DineInn and handle all operations from Cooking to maintaining the building.
The cops are still looking for your father but turns out this building is cursed and many paranormal activities are taking place all around.
Restore the DineInn and uncover its secrets!

Game play Mechanics:

This is mostly a cooking and management sim game with a horror theme and story.
The following game play will be Included in Demo:
- Greet the customers and residents.
- Purchase the ingredients from the convenience store.
- Cook food for the residents and customers.
- Make money for hiring staff for cleaning.
- Find notes and Keys hidden secrets and doors in the basement.
- Uncover the story about what happened to the previous management of DineInn and your dad.

Future plans:
- Add more horror and monsters
- Add jumpscares
- Make a Cozy and Horror game play mode accessible separately in the main menu.
- Expand the map so you will walk to deliver food to campers nearby.
- Add a vehicle for buying and selling products from far away locations.
- Add a Delivery driver for making your delivery runs.
- Add a Traveling merchant for bringing rare items on special occasions.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel i5 5th Gen, Ryzen 5 2nd gen
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 1050 ti / RX 580 4GB
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 250 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any sound card
  • Additional Notes: Designed for optimised gameplay
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel i5 5th Gen, Ryzen 5 2nd gen
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 1050 ti / RX 580 4GB
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Any sound card
  • Additional Notes: Made to run on older devices.
